learned: 2026-10-05, by agent pass: 73 products (69 cannabis, 4 merch tees with size variants), all 'Default Title' variants, prices 0.00. offhours.com is a parked domain; use offhoursbrand.com.
notes: NY only: the site is New York's (NY OCM processor license in the footer), so no state filter is needed.

Titles are short and product_type carries the line and format: 'Originals (Cartridge)', 'Originals (AIO)', 'Off-box', 'Live Rosin AIO', 'Effect-Based AIO', 'Live Rosin' (gummies), 'Gummy Rope', 'Gummies' (effect gummies), 'Low THC', 'Syrup'. The same strain is both an Originals cart and AIO, so product_type decides the subtype.

Size is only in body_html: 'SIZE: 10CT STRENGTH: 100MG THC (10MG/SERVING)' for edibles, 'Size: 0.5g' for the newer vapes, a '1G CARTRIDGE' / '1G ALL-IN-ONE VAPE PEN' header for Originals. The Effect-Based AIO bodies open with '1G ALL-IN-ONE VAPE PEN' but say 'Size: 0.5g', and NY stores sell them as 0.5g, so their rule reads 'Size:'.

Effect products follow the stores' split: the effect name is the line and the FLAVOR field is the strain ('Awaken' + 'Orange Punch', 'Livewire' rope + 'Razz Lemonade'). Numbered Live Rosin drops are '#025 Cultivar “Flavor”'; the quoted flavor is the strain, as stores write it. Ropes are named by cultivar (Gelonade, Berry Pie, and 'Galactic Guava “Passionfruit Mango Guava”', which stores sell as Galactic Guava); that rope's title and type name no line, so it has none. Effect-Based AIOs ('Unwind. (Calm) All-In-One Vape') have no flavor: the name before the dot is the strain.

Daydream's FLAVOR field repeats Jelly RNTZ's ('Strawberry Acai with Coconut'); its description calls it 'Pink Berries' and 13 stores sell it as 'Daydream Pink Berry' (same 10:2:2 THC:CBG:CBC blend). A rule guarded on that description sets the strain; if the description changes, the generic FLAVOR rule takes over.
Stores still sell the old Awaken 'Orangeade' (10:2 THC:THCV); the site's Awaken is now 'Orange Punch' (10:4:2 THC:CBG:THCV), a different product.
Low THC gummies state CBD/CBG/CBN first ('Qty: 20 Gummies Potency: 500mg CBD ... + 20mg THC'). An edible's size is its THC, so Unwind is 20mg; Lights Out and Utopia have no THC and are skipped.

skip.why: no THC (CBD, CBG and CBN only), so no THC dose to size it by
